{{External|rs|rsc=Death Wing}} {{HasTask|Bats|Ghosts}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Death wing |image = [[File:Death wing.png|200px]] |release = [[20 August]] [[2003]] |update = New - Legends Quest! |members = Yes |combat = 83 |size = 2 |examine = A shadowy, barely visible flying entity from some evil place. |attributes = spectral |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 8 (approx) |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 35 |slayxp = 80 |cat = Bats, Ghosts |assignedby = turael,spria,mazchna |hitpoints = 80 |att = 70 |str = 70 |def = 70 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Air |elementalweaknesspercent = 20 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 509 }} '''Death wings''' are flying monsters that appear in the [[Legends' Quest]]. The death wings are located in a remote area, and have no drops, so very few players train on them. Killing a death wing is one of the hard tasks in the [[Karamja Diary]]. Death wings can only be found in the [[Shaman Caves]], which is unlocked during the [[Legends' Quest]]. To reach them, players should bring one or more [[lockpick]]s, a [[machete]], any [[axe]] and any [[pickaxe]]. The dungeon can be found in the north-west of the [[Kharazi Jungle]] by searching the mossy rocks, after which the player should search the bookshelf north of [[Ungadulu]] and choose to squeeze through there, picklock the ancient door, mine the rocks and open another door to reach the death wings. Death wings can also sometimes be found inside [[Barrel (Shaman Caves)|barrels]] in the dungeon. They can be killed for [[bat]] [[Slayer]] tasks, and they give the highest experience out of any monster in this category. They also count for [[ghost]] Slayer tasks. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Death wing |location = [[Shaman Caves]] |levels = 83 |members = Yes |mapID = 10174 |plane = 0 |x:2796,y:9304|x:2799,y:9308|x:2800,y:9301|x:2803,y:9296|x:2806,y:9292|x:2808,y:9308|x:2811,y:9296|x:2811,y:9301 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Karamja }} {{LocTableBottom}} * [[Shaman Caves]] (Possible encounter when smashing [[Barrel (Shaman Caves)|barrels]]) ==Prayer info== {{Prayer info |name = Death wing |level = 40 |xp = 16 |type = spectral }} ==Drops== {{DropLogProject|kills=250}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLineClue|type=beginner|rarity=Rare}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |change = Death Wings now have a 20% [[elemental weakness]] to [[air spells]]. |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat }} {{Subject_changes |date = 6 January 2021 |update = Soul Wars And 20th Anniversary Event |poll = Soul Wars and Minigames |change = Death wings were made into [[Spectral (attribute)|spectral]] creatures. }} {{Subject changes |date = 18 October 2006 |update = Player-Owned House Costume Room |change = The NPC was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Death wing (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Death wing.png|center|300x150px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
